turns.text: Hi, welcome! What total did you get for the pets, and how did you get it?
I got 24. Marcia has 6 and Jan has 18, so I added 6 and 18.
Nice job finding Marcia's and Jan's pets. Which people does the question ask us to count in the total?
Um, the three of them, so Jan, Marcia, and Cindy. Oh, I left out Cindy!
Good catch. So what do you get for the total now?
Nice work. Can you explain why adding those three numbers gives the answer to the question?
Because the question asks for all the pets the three of them have, so I add Cindy's 4, Marcia's 6 and Jan's 18 together.
